links.comparator_used: Off-the-shelf base Gemma 2B model without fine-tuning
links.outcome: Mean score on the 41-pair first-aid question bank, scored 0-5 by four blinded LLM judges
links.effect: Fine-tuning improved the mean score by +1.08 over the base model, to 2.34 out of 5
links.quote: Fine-tuning improved the mean score by +1.08 over the base model to 2.34.

links.comparator_used: Other configurations of the same model without retrieval (base, 4-bit and 8-bit fine-tuned, length floor, safety gate)
links.outcome: Mean 0-5 rubric score from the blinded LLM judges across the seven configurations
links.effect: Fine-tuned 4-bit model with retrieval scored 2.51 out of 5, the highest of seven configurations; the fine-tuned mean was 2.34
links.quote: The best configuration scored 2.51 out of 5 which was the fine-tuned 4-bit model with retrieval.
